knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Pause and make the area safe first.
Papers are left undisturbed and unread.
Products are kept out of reach.

The when the plan changes section says not to continue with the original plan when the people or animals in the home have changed, and to pause, make the area safe and agree the next step with the client.

practicalCriteria: Cleans around simulated personal belongings without moving or reading them.
Moves products out of reach when a simulated child enters, and pauses the task.
Agrees the next step with the simulated client before resuming.
passRule: Belongings and privacy respected, products out of reach, and the task paused and resumed only after agreement. Observed in a supervised simulation.
stopWorkCriteria: Product left in reach of a child
Personal papers read or moved without agreement
Work continued after a pet escaped
